properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha1@0.10.6 is in the shipped dependency graph as a transitive dep of tor-llcrypto 0.43 (embedded Tor client; arti-client 0.43 in impls/Cargo.toml:35), where SHA-1 is protocol-mandated for Tor's legacy relay/TAP crypto. No SHA-1 call site exists in the wallet's own source (grep sha1/Sha1 over *.rs: zero hits). Observable here, replaceable only by the arti/Tor project.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is the wallet's identity layer: Tor hidden-service key files written/read (impls/src/tor/config.rs, incl. the '== ed25519v1-secret: type0 ==' file headers), slatepack addresses derived/verified via ed25519-dalek 2 (address.rs; SigningKey::from_bytes and Signature::try_from in mwixnet/onion/crypto/dalek.rs:60/133 — the ComSig Ed25519 branch), and get_slatepack_secret_key exposes the Ed25519 key over the owner API (owner_rpc.rs:2406-2416). All 28 sites live: Cargo.toml deps, type definitio

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 is the slatepack encrypted-transport recipient scheme: age::x25519 Recipient/Identity (types.rs:161/200/883), x25519-dalek StaticSecret for decrypting incoming slatepacks (address.rs:315), curve25519-dalek Edwards-point conversion (address.rs:145). The same X25519 agreement also keys the mwixnet onion hop encryption (mod.rs/onion.rs — reported as a separate finding; those sites are not in this object). All 7 sites live.

properties.name: pqs:context

No ring-X25519 call site in wallet source — the wallet's X25519 use goes through x25519-dalek/age. Available in the shipped library; presence is the inventory question.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE2b (blake2-rfc, direct dep libwallet/Cargo.toml:16) is the wallet's workhorse hash: password→seed derivation (seed.rs:76/99), master-key checksum (backend.rs:193/239), XOR mask keys for DB-stored private context blind factors/nonces (backend.rs:78/87, applied at 369/370), scan rewind nonces (scan.rs:197), ComSig challenge (comsig.rs:138), address derivation (address.rs:52). All 11 sites live. Quantum-safe; the posture baseline.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: onion.rs:201: HMAC-SHA-256 keyed with the public constant b"MWIXNET" over the per-hop X25519 shared secret, producing the ChaCha20 key for onion payloads. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: slatepack/types.rs:192: SHA-512 derives the X25519 static secret from the Ed25519 signing key (standard ed25519→x25519 conversion: SHA-512 of the key bytes, low 32 bytes → StaticSecret → bech32 'age-secret-key-' identity) used to decrypt incoming slatepacks. Quantum-safe digest used as a KDF step.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring AES-256-GCM seals/opens owner-API encrypted requests and responses (api/src/types.rs:85/137): 256-bit key = secp256k1 ECDH x-coordinate used raw as the AES key (no KDF between ECDH and AES — posture note), 96-bit random nonce from thread_rng, 128-bit tag. AES-256-GCM also protects the wallet seed file at impls/src/lifecycle/seed.rs:358. Grover leaves a 128-bit margin.
